name: Kr8Kan
// command: The launch logic lives in the script, not here — it needs shell quoting, and a command containing double quotes does not survive mkmacapp's Swift codegen. See scripts/macapp-server.sh for why it does not just run `pnpm dev:next`.
// preferred_port: Pinned, not auto. NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3310 drives better-auth's baseURL and trustedOrigins, so serving on any other port breaks sign-in. Change both together or not at all.
// health_path: Empty on purpose — wait for the port to accept TCP. Do not point this at /api/agents/health: it returns 500 whenever the Pi CLI is unreachable, which the shell reads as 'never ready', so the window never opens even though the app is serving fine.
